title: Guest interns at the PEAR lab

tellings.quote:
And then I got in contact
with uh the pair lab. Yeah. Princeton
engineering anomalies research lab.

plain: Around 2003, an unnamed researcher who appears as a guest says they got in touch with the Princeton Engineering Anomalies Research lab, a Princeton University group that studied whether the human mind could affect machines and events, and went to intern there. The guest tells this from their own experience and names the lab's leaders, Brenda Dunne and Robert Jahn.
